units: Car GLB native units (KFB_CVP1_cabrio.glb, scale 1). Character values in KayKit rig units. World metres = rig units x 0.616 (scale A).

driverSeat.note: FB sits 0.10 rig units further forward than the seat centre + 0.12*carScale so its arms reach the wheel

steeringWheel.note: move the SteeringWheel node (rim + spokes) by -0.0556 * axis; body/ears vs rim measured 0 overlaps at this shift, belly hits the rim at 0.10 native

hands.ik: 2-bone IK on upperarm/lowerarm, target = grip point on the rim, pole outward-down
hands.beyondFollow: rim turns under the hands; grips stay at their car-space angle (no hand-over-hand yet)
hands.measured: wrist-to-grip 0.000-0.024 rig at frames 80/140/200 with the shifted wheel; shoulder-to-grip / arm length 1.01-1.05 at 10/2, 1.04-1.08 at +-20 deg, 1.09-1.13 at +-40 deg

feet.pedals: not reached: right toe is 0.26 rig units short of the gas pedal; legs hang (look decision open)

ears.cabrioOpen: free; FB-EARS-FLOPPY-01 'B Floppy' with wind = -vehicle velocity (m/s)

hop.path: quadratic Bezier hips path, control point 0.15 behind the midpoint, apex so the lowest FB vertex clears the door top
hop.yaw: +90 -> 180 deg during flight (turn to face forward), ease in/out
hop.poses: stand -> crouch (45% towards seated) -> seated pose held in flight (tuck) -> land with 0.07 dip; IK influence 0 in flight, eases to 1 over the landing
hop.exit: mirror: dip in seat, fly out to the left, land facing away (-X), rise to stand
outFixes: arm IK influence reaches 0 by the last frame of dipOut
ear dangle stiffened during dipOut/hopOut/landOut (stiffness x3 or blend 0.7 to rest), released over the 10 landing frames
no knee straightening during the hop; blend leg pose in after the landing dip

drive.lean: expressive only, clamp +-0.10 rad (proposal; Georg decides); never used to reach the wheel
drive.bounce: spring as v0.1, input x0.25, hips clamp +-0.03 m (from J17)
drive.carBodyRoll: 0 when the runtime already rolls the car body (Joyride J10/K2B); -0.012*lateralAccel rad only in a runtime without roll
drive.earsSeated: FB upright: whole floppy envelope (back 0-90, out +-55) has 0 overlaps with the cabrio; optional wind cap 12 m/s while seated (starting value)

testTrack.shape: ellipse a 24, b 16 rig units, hump 0.9

measuredFindings: Mixamo entering/exiting clips do not fit FB in the cabrio at x1.8: door sill is about 2x FB's hip height; after 2 repair passes FB still passed through side wall, door and seat -> replaced by the hop (Georg 30.09).
Side windows reach 2.53 (scaled) and block the hop; roll them down (hide) in the cabrio.
Interior mirror sits in front of FB's mouth.
v0.1 defect: hands never reached the grips (wrist 0.07-0.12 rig short); fixed in 0.2 by the wheel shift (FB-CABRIO-JOYRIDE-02).
changes: 0.2 (FB-CABRIO-JOYRIDE-02): steering wheel 0.0556 native (0.10 rig) closer to FB along -axis; grip follow capped at +-30 deg; reach-lean removed; car body roll only where the runtime has none; bounce cap and mirror offset taken from J17; v0.1 hands did not reach the wheel (wrist 0.07-0.12 rig short).
